name: The Roof Arrives by Rail
prompt: Build a glass exhibition pavilion in stages. Rail wagons deliver curved iron ribs, riggers lift one arch, and the finished glazed bay already holds a crowd.

name: The Cloth That Circles the Hall
prompt: Run a continuous ribbon of patterned cloth from looms through a tall exhibition gallery. Visitors walk under its folds while dyers feed a fresh colour into the weaving shed.

name: The Great Pump Court
prompt: Face three different exhibition pumps toward a common stepped fountain. Their differently shaped jets land in separate bowls, letting spectators compare the machines at a glance.

name: The Cabinet Parade
prompt: Put specimen cabinets on little rails beneath an exhibition canopy. Porters roll a cabinet of shells past one of mineral crystals to form a new display at the public entrance.

name: The Ice Pavilion
prompt: Build a refrigerated display hall inside a warm glass exhibition arcade. Ice carvers work under insulated copper panels as glaziers wipe condensation from the viewing windows.
